Messages.Author: Brian Reed
Messages.Body:
To all:
Can you tap the Courier the turn it comes out?

Courier [SW]
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Nosferatu antitribu
Cost: 2 blood
Ally with 1 life. 0 strength. 1 bleed. Courier gets -1 intercept when
attempting to block a vampire. When a minion you control successfully
bleeds, you may look at the top card of the library of the Methuselah being
bled, and you may tap the Courier to discard that card.

Brian

Messages.Author: theve...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <bR6e6.181$tS.2...@typhoon.austin.rr.com>,

Interesting question. The rulebook states that an ally cannot act the
turn it is created which wouldn't preclude you from tapping it to burn
a card. however it also states that the ally is placed in your
uncontrolled region until the end of your turn to indicate that it
cannot act even though it is controlled. card text doesn't say you
cannot use it the turn it is created so i would say that you can use
it. that's how i'd judge it in a tourney anyway.

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/
